title: PlanRequest
description: servtuner plan's input (Planner inputs): the traffic to plan for, the SLO, availability and overrides. The capacity models are passed beside it.

baseline_rps.description: Off-peak traffic, for the HPA minimum. Without it, the minimum is the availability floor.

slos.description: The SLO to plan for. It need not be the one the runs used: the per-replica capacity is recomputed from the stored curves, interpolating only between measured stages.

workload_hash.description: Plan only models measured with this request mix; required when the models disagree.

spare.description: N+1: one replica beyond what the peak needs.

zones.description: Replicas are rounded up to a multiple of this.

overrides.description: Scenario overrides on the plan's derivation nodes.

overrideKind.description: Named apart from the recommendations' subject kind: two generated enums both called Kind collided in the api's OpenAPI document.
